description: Component for monitoring filesystem directories for new files.

directory_path.label: Directory Path
directory_path.description: Path to the directory to monitor for new files

file_pattern.label: File Pattern
file_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match files (e.g., '.*\.csv$' for CSV files)

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when files are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

batch_into_one_run.label: Batch Into One Run
batch_into_one_run.description: Launch ONE run per check that found new files, instead of one per file -- for a job that processes the whole folder each time (e.g. an extractor listing a directory), where a run per file would repeat the same work. While a run of the job is still going the sensor waits (without moving its cursor), so files that arrive meanwhile are picked up by the next run rather than processed twice. Only with partition_mode='run_config'.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

partition_mode.label: Partition Mode
partition_mode.description: How the sensor surfaces detected files: 'run_config' (default — embed file metadata in run_config), 'static_partition' (yield RunRequest(partition_key=<from partition_key_template>) — use when the target asset has a static/dynamic partitions_def), or 'dynamic_partition' (also registers each key on the given DynamicPartitionsDefinition first).

partition_key_template.label: Partition Key Template
partition_key_template.description: Template for the partition key per detected file. Fields: {file_path}, {file_name}, {file_stem} (filename without extension). Default `{file_stem}` — e.g. `/tmp/approvals/t3.json` → `t3`.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Required when partition_mode='dynamic_partition'. Must match the downstream asset's `dynamic_partition_name:` field.

dynamic_partition_keep_days.label: Dynamic Partition Keep Days
dynamic_partition_keep_days.description: When set (partition_mode='dynamic_partition'), partitions this sensor registered are deleted once older than this many days -- dynamic partitions otherwise accumulate forever. Tracked via a small local JSON state file (dynamic_partition_state_path), independent of the sensor's own cursor. Unset (default): no pruning.

dynamic_partition_state_path.label: Dynamic Partition State Path
dynamic_partition_state_path.description: Where dynamic_partition_keep_days persists its {partition_key: first_seen} state. Defaults to './{sensor_name}_dynamic_partition_state.json'. Ignored when dynamic_partition_keep_days is unset.

min_age_seconds.label: Min Age Seconds
min_age_seconds.description: Skip a file whose mtime is younger than this many seconds -- it may still be being written or transferred in. Checked against the file's mtime at the time of this tick, not when it first appeared. Unset (default): no age check.

min_size_bytes.label: Min Size Bytes
min_size_bytes.description: Skip a file smaller than this many bytes -- catches a file that exists but hasn't finished being written/copied yet. Unset (default): no size check.

require_stable_size.label: Require Stable Size
require_stable_size.description: Skip a file whose size has changed since the last tick this sensor ran (tracked via file_stability_state_path, independent of the mtime cursor) -- catches an in-progress write/transfer even when mtime keeps advancing (e.g. a slow copy that touches the file continuously) and min_age_seconds alone wouldn't. A file seen for the first time is always skipped and re-checked next tick, so every file gets at least one full tick of delay before it can ever fire.

file_stability_state_path.label: File Stability State Path
file_stability_state_path.description: Where require_stable_size persists its {file_path: last_seen_size} state. Defaults to './{sensor_name}_file_stability_state.json'. Ignored when require_stable_size is false.

name: Filesystem Monitor
